entities.name: Ognis
entities.description: Viashino engineer, boiler and first captain of the Riveteers, overseer of Halo trade in the Caldaia.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: New Capenna crime family led by the dragon Ziatora.

entities.name: Ziatora
entities.description: Demon dragon leader of the Riveteers whose image Ognis shares.

entities.name: Caldaia
entities.description: District where Ognis oversees the Halo trade.

events.summary: Ognis is granted Ziatora's coveted green flame and remains on the front lines with her comrades.
events.quote: remains one of the few to be granted Ziatora's coveted green flame

relations.note: She is a viashino warrior of the family.
relations.quote: Ognis is a viashino warrior of the Riveteers family in New Capenna
